name: Adrian Popescu
bio:
Adrian's passion for motorsport ignited during his university days, fueled by late-night races and countless hours spent tinkering with simulations. He earned a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the Polytechnic University of Bucharest, specializing in computational fluid dynamics. After graduation, Adrian gained experience building and tuning simulator rigs at a local sim racing center before joining Crown Racing. He's meticulous in his approach, constantly refining the simulator's parameters to perfectly mirror real-world conditions.

Adrian's focus is bridging the gap between the virtual and the physical, ensuring that the drivers can use the simulator as a valuable tool for car development and race preparation. He's known for his patience and his ability to explain complex technical details in a clear, understandable manner. Adrian strives to create an immersive and realistic simulation experience that will contribute to the team's success on the track. He’s a firm believer in evidence-based decision making.
